sessions.topic: Establish reproducible criteria for background-dependent epistasis sign reversals
sessions.boundary_reason: Reversal-label criteria and an independent assay audit are complete; the discussion shifts to background representation.

sessions.topic: Select pathway-burden embeddings for held-out backgrounds and plan prospective testing
sessions.boundary_reason: A representation is selected and prospective testing is planned; a different transfer approach begins.

sessions.topic: Test response-profile neighbor transfer and the effect of masking constituent singles
sessions.boundary_reason: Masking undermines the initial result, prompting a revised neighbor method.

sessions.topic: Test pathway-constrained neighbors and sensitivity to donor availability
sessions.boundary_reason: Withholding nearest donors exposes a limitation and motivates gated transfer.

sessions.topic: Evaluate and select cosine-gated transfer with pathway-burden fallback
sessions.boundary_reason: The revised transfer method is selected; the next stage tests it prospectively.

sessions.topic: Prospectively validate gated transfer in four new backgrounds
sessions.boundary_reason: Prospective results support a selection decision; a transcriptome-based approach begins.

sessions.topic: Test wild-type transcriptome gating and batch correction on Prospective-150
sessions.boundary_reason: Corrected gating is adopted for further testing; the next stage uses blinded combinations.

sessions.topic: Blindly test transcriptome gating and assess whether parental RNA drives predictions
sessions.boundary_reason: RNA shuffling prompts a decision to defer deployment and revise the validation plan.
